_note: Raw LLM output for the CBA (Código Brasileiro de Aeronáutica) framework analysis. Chaining mode: 'all' — receives the cumulative results from MC99 (position 1) as prior context. The authoritative v2.4-compliant canonical output is in 04_synthesized_outputs/golden_case_canonical_output.json.

chaining_context._note: CBA analysis ran with full MC99 results in context. Chaining mode 'all' means the LLM sees all prior framework violations when determining CBA applicability, avoiding duplicate fact extraction.

violations.description: Carrier breached its contractual service obligation under CBA Art.175 §2 by refusing to provide alternative transport or any assistance to a passenger whose connection was missed due to operational delay, violating the service contract relationship established between carrier and passenger under Brazilian aviation law.
violations._spec: CBA-specific violation. Distinct from VIOL_mc99v001 even though same incident — different legal frameworks create distinct legal allegations. Do NOT merge multi-framework violations into one node.

actions.description: Carrier agent directed passenger to file a written complaint and offered no immediate assistance — no meal vouchers, no accommodation, no rebooking — despite the delay being caused by the carrier's own operational failure.
actions._spec: ACTN_noasst01 is new to CBA analysis. Not a duplicate of ACTN_deny0001 — it is a distinct observable behavior (failure to assist vs explicit refusal to reroute). Chaining context from MC99 provided ACTN_deny0001 already, so the CBA LLM correctly identifies the additional action.

evidences.source: Audio/video recording of passenger-carrier interaction at departure counter, file /payload/recording.mp4.
evidences._spec: Same Evidence node as MC99 analysis. Correct — one Evidence object covers the full interaction. Do not duplicate Evidence nodes across frameworks for the same recording.

segments.text: Passenger is informed to file a written complaint; assistance is not offered.
segments.speaker: airline_staff
segments._spec: SEG_seg00003 grounds ACTN_noasst01 — the carrier's statement about filing a written complaint (with no assistance offered) is the direct factual basis for the CBA service failure violation.

actors.context: Carrier check-in and service agent at departure counter
Ticketed passenger on delayed international flight requesting assistance

articles.article_reference: CBA Title VI, Chapter I, Article 175 — Public Air Services Scope
articles.article_text: Art. 175. Os serviços aéreos públicos abrangem os serviços aéreos especializados públicos e os serviços de transporte aéreo público de passageiro, carga ou mala postal, regular ou não regular, doméstico ou internacional. § 1° A relação jurídica entre a União e o empresário que explora os serviços aéreos públicos pauta-se pelas normas estabelecidas neste Código e legislação complementar e pelas condições da respectiva concessão ou autorização. § 2º A relação jurídica entre o empresário e o usuário ou beneficiário dos serviços é contratual, regendo-se pelas respectivas normas previstas neste Código e legislação complementar, e, em se tratando de transporte público internacional, pelo disposto nos Tratados e Convenções pertinentes (artigos 1°, § 1°; 203 a 213). § 3° No contrato de serviços aéreos públicos, o empresário, pessoa física ou jurídica, proprietário ou explorador da aeronave, obriga-se, em nome próprio, a executar determinados serviços aéreos, mediante remuneração, aplicando-se o disposto nos artigos 222 a 245 quando se tratar de transporte aéreo regular.
articles._spec: CBA Art.175 §2 establishes the contractual service obligation. The carrier's refusal to assist directly violates this article. PRECISION RULE: Art.260 (baggage limits) is NOT cited here because the factual basis is denied rerouting, not baggage damage.

articles.article_reference: CBA Title VIII, Chapter III, Article 260 — Liability Limits for Baggage Damage
articles.article_text: Art. 260. A responsabilidade do transportador por dano, conseqüente da destruição, perda ou avaria da bagagem despachada ou conservada em mãos do passageiro, ocorrida durante a execução do contrato de transporte aéreo, limita-se ao valor correspondente a 150 (cento e cinqüenta) Obrigações do Tesouro Nacional - OTN, por ocasião do pagamento, em relação a cada passageiro.
articles._spec: Art.260 is LOADED under BR.CBA (CONTAINS_ARTICLE) but NOT cited via VIOLATES_ARTICLE. Demonstrates the CONTAINS_ARTICLE vs VIOLATES_ARTICLE distinction — loading ≠ citing. Baggage liability is irrelevant to this scenario.
